tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yaʿaqov, from the root ʿ-q-b, 'heel' (Genesis 25:26). Its root is Hebrew ʿ-q-b. Jacob, son of Isaac (Genesis 25). Jacob is a Hebrew name meaning “Supplanter; one who grasps the heel”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
